basic_info.description: Charming Parkside 2 bedroom 1 bath home built in 1927.  Living room with corner fireplace, separate formal dining room, oak hardwood floors, adorable 1950's kitchen with vintage oven/range and original tile bathroom with tub and separate stall shower.  Full basement provides 2 car tandem parking, laundry room, storage room and further expansion potential.  Rear brick patio and large rear yard.  Wonderful home ready for your remodeling and gardening ideas and conveniently located 2 blocks to Taraval St public transit, shops, restaurants and services.
